supported_claims: MIT notice, attribution condition and warranty disclaimer inspected; transitive and dataset rights remain separate.
Cutoff source declares version1.39.0, Python>=3.10, lower-bounded dependencies and optional stacks, and CLI/MCP entrypoints. The JOSS archive1.23.0 is a different version.
Only method is required. CI length/order, nonnegative SE, probability range and observation-count integrality are not enforced.
Import-free schema bundle description; exported result schema matches the inspected permissive contract. Generator functions are inspected, not executed.

Evidence taxonomy separates aliases, helpers, cross-package references and internal fixtures. Eight Python-reference entries contradict the stale comment saying two. Aggregation differences refute an alias.
Typed JSON-RPC exception codes; these do not by themselves establish causal identification or successful tool execution.

Working-paper and distribution claims do not establish independent adoption. Open-source package and commercial downstream product are separate; wider dossier numerical claims not reproduced.
Tests specify underidentified-IV typed errors and retention of diagnostics/alternatives. Test source inspected, no native test run or failure claimed.

Saved-fixture tests specify estimator/statistic-specific tolerances, shared DML folds and nonunique SCM limits. RD standard-error tolerance can be7% although point tolerances are much tighter. No external results reproduced.
limitations: Static primary-source review and project-authored schema/arithmetic witnesses only; no downloaded package code executed.

supported_claims: Method-only, semantically invalid and empty-interval payloads pass the inspected JSON schema; wrong method type fails.
Two equal-sized customer cohorts with effects4/-4 and post-period counts3/1 give customer effect0 and treated-observation effect2; stipulated per-customer cost1 gives net-1 for the customer decision.
Two copies of a262144-byte structured JSON payload contribute at least524288 payload bytes before the enclosing envelope, escaping and any image.
